title: Super Bowl LIII
overview: Super Bowl LIII, played on February 3, 2019, at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta, Georgia, was a game that saw the New England Patriots defeat the Los Angeles Rams 13-3, capturing their sixth Super Bowl title. This victory further cemented Tom Brady’s legacy as one of the greatest quarterbacks of all time and marked the end of a hard-fought, defense-dominated championship.
